031
STUDY 060
Pearl Drop & Printed Blouse
Rights check
Source: 24413.jpg
Romantic, polished, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The copper hair against black is the strongest contrast.
- Use 'close-up, head and shoulders' for a tighter crop.
Try this: Try a head-and-shoulders close-up.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with
copper-red hair swept back from her
face wears a single pearl drop earring
and a black blouse with a small white
printed motif. Her expression is calm,
with soft peach lips and a direct gaze.
Soft, even studio light against a plain
pale backdrop. Palette of black, ivory,
and copper. Romantic and polished, in
the style of a runway beauty editorial.
